text_block_list.text:
On my day off, I spotted Symboli Kris S 
and Hishi Amazon near the school gates.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...Sorry for putting it all on your 
shoulders. But it's for everyone in the 
dorm... We're counting on ya!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Understood.

...Thinking about how cryptic that 
exchange was, I continued walking through 
the streets.

Suddenly, an intimidating presence loomed 
behind me. Startled, I turned around――and 
there stood Symboli Kris S.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —I have—business with you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —This is it.

And then, thrust right before my eyes was 
an image on a smartphone. It was――

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Do you—recognize it?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—This company's— this brand's—tail 
shampoo.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —I see. —Thank you—for your cooperation.

And with that, Symboli Kris S swiftly 
sprinted away. ...What on earth was that 
all about?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
—Well now, good work! That was a 
magnificent job, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
There was a mix-up with the order, ya see. 
Before we knew it, the dorm's tail shampoo 
had practically run out.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
So I asked Kris S to run the errand for 
me. There were so many different brands, 
but she managed to get every single one!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—To be precise...— There is one—I could 
not locate.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, the one that keeps humidity from 
puffing it up? Wait, but you found me the 
closest match in ingredients instead, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, I can head into races with 
my tail in prime condition even on 
overcast days.

Bags from various drugstores were piled at 
Symboli Kris S's feet. Just how many shops 
did she visit...?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Weight and distance—predicted. —No 
problem.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—See the job through to the end. —That is 
my creed.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
There's no need to go as far as using 
styling products like on rainy days. 
During humid seasons, I just use shampoo 
daily to prep against the moisture.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
――I will do――everything I can. 
――Naturally.
